remediation.suggestion: Pin firebase-tools to a reviewed version or ask the user before running latest npm or npx commands.
Prefer a project-local dev dependency or document the global install as an optional manual step.

remediation.issue: Firebase project enumeration and provisioning commands
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation and show the selected project before running projects:list, apps:list, or init ailogic.

content.user_title: Integrate Firebase AI Logic in Apps
content.value_statement: Adding Gemini features to Firebase apps requires platform-specific setup and production safeguards. This skill provides focused Firebase AI Logic guidance for web, mobile, and Flutter projects.
actual_capabilities: Guides Firebase AI Logic setup for web, Android, iOS, and Flutter apps.
Provides initialization patterns for Gemini Developer API with Firebase SDKs.
Covers text generation, chat sessions, streaming responses, and multimodal input.
Explains structured output, model selection, and Remote Config usage.
Highlights App Check, safety settings, and Firebase production requirements.
limitations: Requires current Firebase documentation for exact SDK versions and pricing.
Does not replace user approval for Firebase CLI commands.
Does not design secure backend workflows for sensitive data by itself.
Focuses on setup and usage patterns, not complete application architecture.

use_cases.title: Add Gemini to a mobile app
use_cases.description: Use platform guidance to set up Firebase AI Logic in Android, iOS, or Flutter projects.

use_cases.title: Build AI features in a web app
use_cases.description: Use Firebase Web SDK patterns for text, chat, streaming, multimodal input, and image generation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a production rollout
use_cases.description: Review App Check, Remote Config, provider choice, and safety settings before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Start Firebase AI Logic setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a known platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up Firebase AI Logic for my [platform] app. Confirm prerequisites, project setup, and the safest first implementation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add text and chat generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through adding text generation and a multi-turn chat session with Firebase AI Logic in my [platform] project.

prompt_templates.title: Design multimodal streaming
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Firebase AI Logic feature that accepts text and images, streams responses, and handles loading and error states.

prompt_templates.title: Review production readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Firebase AI Logic rollout plan for App Check, provider selection, model configuration, safety settings, and command approval risks.

output_examples.input: Help me add Firebase AI Logic to a Flutter app.
output: Confirm Firebase is initialized before AI Logic usage.
Use Firebase CLI provisioning before Flutter client configuration.
Add the required Flutter packages and authenticate the user.
Create a Gemini model through the Firebase AI SDK.
Test generation with App Check planned before production.

output_examples.input: What should I check before launching Firebase AI Logic?
output: Enable App Check for the app before production traffic.
Confirm the selected Gemini API provider and billing plan.
Move model names to Remote Config when updates are expected.
Review safety settings and user-facing error handling.
Ask before running Firebase CLI commands that change project state.

output_examples.input: Can this skill help with multimodal features?
output_examples.output: Yes. It covers image and file inputs, streaming responses, chat sessions, and platform-specific Firebase SDK patterns.

best_practices: Confirm the target platform and Firebase project before setup.
Use App Check and safety settings before production release.
Check official Firebase docs for current SDK versions and provider requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not run Firebase CLI commands without user confirmation.
Do not hardcode model names when Remote Config is appropriate.
Do not skip Firebase initialization order or App Check planning.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers web, Android, iOS, and Flutter setup. The overview also mentions Unity support.

faq.question: Does Firebase AI Logic require a backend?
faq.answer: It can call Gemini from client SDKs, but Firebase service provisioning and App Check remain important.

faq.question: Which Gemini API provider should I use?
faq.answer: The guidance recommends Gemini Developer API by default. Use Vertex AI Gemini API only for enterprise requirements.

faq.question: Can it handle image or file input?
faq.answer: Yes. The references describe multimodal input for images, audio, video, PDFs, and file URLs.

faq.question: Is it ready for production apps?
faq.answer: It includes production guidance, but you still need App Check, safety settings, billing review, and user approval for commands.

faq.question: Will the skill execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: No command should run without user approval. The skill includes Firebase CLI examples that need confirmation.
